prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Baytown, Texas. Injury: back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1029; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Baytown, Texas, when the car behind me struck the rear of my vehicle. The impact was firm enough to push me forward against my seatbelt, and I felt a sharp pain in my lower back almost immediately. I exchanged information with the other driver at the scene and gave the same description of what happened to the officer who responded, to the adjuster, and to the medical staff I saw afterward. I am the named driver on this policy, and I have been consistent in every conversation about how the collision occurred. Since the accident I have been dealing with a back strain that limits how long I can sit or lift, and I am following the treatment plan my doctor recommended.
